## Summary

Fix the intermittent failure of `workflow::orchestrator::tests::parse_retry_attempts_four_with_session_followup_and_token_metrics` that occurs in `nix build` (musl cross-compilation, sandboxed environment) but passes in local `cargo test`.

## Failure Details

The test fails with:
```
assertion `left == right` failed: expected one token-metrics log event per normalization call
  left: 1
 right: 4
```

The `MetricsCaptureLayer` tracing subscriber only captures 1 event instead of the expected 4 during the parse retry loop.

## Reproduction Context

- **Fails**: `nix build` (musl target, sandboxed, release mode)
- **Passes**: `nix develop -c cargo test` (debug mode)
- **Passes**: `nix develop -c cargo test --release` (release mode, glibc)

## Root Cause Hypothesis

The `tracing::subscriber::with_default()` thread-local subscriber may behave differently under the musl libc implementation in the nix sandbox. Alternatively, there could be a timing issue with the `tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()` runtime and the `tracing` event dispatch when compiled against musl.

## Code Locations

- Test: `src/workflow/orchestrator.rs` ~ line 6641
- Tracing layer: `MetricsCaptureLayer` ~ line 6559
- Function under test: `execute_with_parse_retries` ~ line 4755

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test passes consistently in `nix build` environment (musl target)
- [ ] Test continues to pass in local `cargo test` (debug and release modes)
- [ ] All 4 token-metrics events are captured correctly across all build configurations
- [ ] No regressions in other tests in the `workflow::orchestrator::tests` module
